notes: Not published on Play, so it is not offered for installation and is installed by hand. The entry exists because network access is decided here: a package that is not in the catalog gets nothing, whatever its policy says. Two certificates are accepted while this app is still in development: the release key (C=IL, O=abaye, CN=abaye) and the debug key of the machine it is built on (C=US, O=Android, CN=Android Debug), which is what is installed on the test device today. Drop the debug entry once the app ships.
